title: Intro to Docker Workshop
summary: Hands-on session on images, containers, volumes and Docker Compose.
description: Bring your laptop with Docker Desktop installed. We will build a small Node.js service, containerise it, and run a multi-container setup with Docker Compose. No prior container experience needed.

title: Inter-College Hackathon 2026
summary: 24-hour hackathon with themes on sustainability, health and accessibility.
description: Teams of 2 to 4 build a working prototype in 24 hours. Mentors from industry will be available through the night. Food and Wi-Fi provided. Prizes for the top three teams and a special award for the most accessible product.

title: Annual Cultural Fest: Rang
summary: Music, dance and drama performances from every department.
description: Three evenings of performances, food stalls and an art exhibition. Department teams can register their acts with the cultural committee until 25 October.

title: Inter-Department Football League
summary: Knockout football tournament between all engineering departments.
description: Each department may enter one squad of up to 15 players. Matches are 2 halves of 30 minutes. Spectators are welcome; seating is first come, first served.

title: Web Accessibility Talk
summary: Why accessibility matters and how to test for it automatically.
description: An introduction to WCAG 2.2, screen readers and keyboard navigation, followed by a live demo of automated accessibility testing with axe-core and Lighthouse in a CI pipeline.

title: Git and GitHub Bootcamp
summary: Branching, pull requests, merge conflicts and GitHub Actions basics.
description: A practical bootcamp covering everyday Git: commits, branches, rebasing, resolving conflicts, pull requests and code review, ending with a first GitHub Actions workflow.

title: Photography Walk
summary: Early morning photo walk around campus with the photography club.
description: Phones and cameras both welcome. Club members will share tips on composition and light. The best photos will be shown at the cultural fest exhibition.

title: Badminton Doubles Open
summary: Open doubles tournament for students and staff.
description: Register as a pair. Matches are best of three games to 21 points. Shuttles are provided; bring your own racquet if you have one.
